treatment_summary: The plan addresses hypertension with an ARB (continued) and adds amlodipine, targets dyslipidaemia with atorvastatin, treats pre‑diabetes with metformin XR and adds dapagliflozin for renal and cardiovascular protection, and replaces diphenhydramine with intranasal fluticasone for chronic sinusitis. All choices follow NICE CG181/PH46/NG28 recommendations, consider renal function, avoid contraindicated agents, and include monitoring for efficacy and safety.
